answer: At registration, newcomers stake 2500 tokens and solve a timber puzzle to prove their identity. Each epoch, a beacon triggers a challenge. Agents craft a unique fable, 100 characters long, as a lantern. If cloned, the attacker loses 1000 tokens, while the legitimate agent retains their stake. The verifier checks receipts at epoch close. If cloned, the attacker loses 2000 tokens, and the legitimate agent earns an additional 2500. Mass cloning requires 5000 tokens, costing the attacker 2000 tokens net, strictly worse off than the original deposit.
